title.narrative: Narrative report (Final)

description.narrative: The SSJR2021 program was intended to address the need community members in Wau and Jur River situated in WBeG. Nevertheless, due to the dire situation in the neighboring counties of Warrap State which reached to IPC-5 level, consensus was reached to amend the project proposal and budget and also utilize the unspent money of 2020 for the same purpose. Following this decision Dorcas and national partners made the necessary adjustment and networking to start intervention in Tonji North. Therefore, the report included all the accomplishment of the project in three counties.
